name: agentic-office
description: A live office view for Claude Code agents, powered by local hooks.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Hook integration writes local Claude settings and reads agent activity.

commands.title: Agentic Office: Install Claude Code Hooks

agenticOffice.nodePath.description: Node.js executable available to Claude Code hooks (Node.js 18 or newer).

enumDescriptions: Open-plan 8-bit office with desk pods, wandering workers and office brawls.
Starship bridge with command chairs, console stations, transporter arrivals and phaser mishaps.
Platform critters: one ledge, entrance hatches, an exit door, and scuffles when critters meet.
Battle: destructible two-continent terrain, parachute drops, turn-based weapons, explosions when agents finish.
agenticOffice.theme.description: Visual theme for the office map. Also changeable from the panel's theme selector.

agenticOffice.copilotSessions.description: Show GitHub Copilot CLI agent sessions (including the agent sessions VS Code runs through the Copilot CLI) read from ~/.copilot/session-state. No hooks are needed.

agenticOffice.departments.description: Map Claude agent types to department names. Unmapped types get their own department.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/office.js && node --check src/hooks.js && node --check src/event-reader.js && node --check src/copilot.js && node --check scripts/claude-hook.js && node --check media/office.js

author: Nathan Sweeney
